findings.issue: "Strictly noodles though, so don't come in craving a burger" reads like it was written for this puzzle. It points straight at today's craving, which feels meta. The card already shows the cuisine, so the line isn't needed as evidence.
findings.suggested_fix: Plenty of tofu and veggie broth bowls. It's noodles or nothing here, and I'm not complaining.

findings.issue: Brisket Box tells the player it fails on the vegetarian diet before they read a review. Bun Stop's name also hints at a quick stop, which nudges toward the answer. The venue-name rule only starts at level_06, so this is advisory for an approved level, and recurring venues keep their names.
findings.suggested_fix: No change to this approved level. Keep in mind for any future campus decoys: use neutral names (e.g. 'Grill Yard' instead of 'Brisket Box').

summary: A warm, well-paced first implied level. Mina's vegetarianism comes out through Liam's fries callback (rule 6), and every deciding attribute (meat-only, slow table service, veggie patty, speed) is clearly evidenced in the reviews. The Brisket Box beef-fat fries pay off Mina's 'i can just get fries' nicely. Voices and outcomes are on model, with no recap line and no continuity issues; the only notes are a slightly meta review and decoy names that would break the later level_06 naming rule.
